query.statement: SELECT WO_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSIGNEE_ID, ISSUED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, STATUS, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK FROM CMMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC
SELECT STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM CMMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY STATUS

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM CMMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM CMMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE SCHEDULED_DATE <= @asOf AND STATUS NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled') ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE

SELECT WO_ID, PLAN_ID, EQUIPMENT_ID, WO_TYPE, DESCRIPTION, ASSIGNEE_ID, ISSUED_AT, STARTED_AT, COMPLETED_AT, STATUS, FAILURE_CODE_ID, REMARK FROM CMMS_WORK_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY ISSUED_AT DESC

SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME, EQUIPMENT_ID, PLAN_TYPE, CYCLE_TYPE, SCHEDULED_DATE, ESTIMATED_DURATION_HOURS, ASSIGNEE_ID, STATUS FROM CMMS_MAINTENANCE_PLAN WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@equipmentId IS NULL OR EQUIPMENT_ID = @equipmentId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY SCHEDULED_DATE
SELECT PART_ID, PART_NAME, PART_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CURRENT_STOCK, MIN_STOCK, MAX_STOCK, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID FROM CMMS_SPARE_PART WITH (NOLOCK) ORDER BY PART_NAME

SELECT PART_ID, PART_NAME, PART_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, UNIT_OF_MEASURE, CURRENT_STOCK, MIN_STOCK, MAX_STOCK, LOCATION, EQUIPMENT_CLASS_ID FROM CMMS_SPARE_PART WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE CURRENT_STOCK <= MIN_STOCK ORDER BY PART_NAME
